common_model.date_weights: equal total training weight per exchange date
common_model.walk_forward: calendar-month expanding; every fitted date strictly before score month
common_model.portfolio: daily top1 at 100% and top2 at 50/50

hypotheses.market_return: Each completed date's cross-sectional median open-to-close return among price_training_eligible and observed rows.
hypotheses.beta: For each code/date, rolling OLS slope of stock open-to-close return on the same completed-date market return over the previous 60 observed eligible sessions, minimum 20; beta is shifted one code session and clipped to [-3,3]. Missing beta is 1 only for target construction.
hypotheses.residual_target: stock open-to-close return - prior_beta * same-date market open-to-close return
hypotheses.prediction: Removing contemporaneous common-market payoff from the training target improves ranking of idiosyncratic same-day winners.
